title: Additivity in the First Matrix Argument
statement: Let $N$ be a natural number, let $A$ and $B$ be $N\times N$ matrices over $\mathbb{F}_2$, and let $z$ be a vector of length $N$ over $\mathbb{F}_2$. Pairing $A+B$ with the matrix whose $(i,j)$ entry is $z_i z_j$ gives the sum of the pairings of $A$ and $B$ with that matrix.
hypotheses_covered: $z$ is a vector of length $N$ over $\mathbb{F}_2$
